G1_joint.argument: [ARGUED] every commitment's opened functionals are blinded by its OWN reserved rows, pads and salts (one generator per run, distinct draws per commitment: G-R4, the stage-47 replay); a combination of functionals of two commitments is blinding-free only if each part is, so the joint blinding-free space restricted to the identified data coordinates has dimension at most the sum of the per-commitment disclosed dimensions, which is 0 for every commitment holding a new plane (A-in, E-token-in, B0, B_L, A-out, E-token-out) -- ruling R-3: joint = sum of parts is a model consistency check, not independence (G-R4's job)
G1_joint.computed: per commitment (G1_per_commitment) and on each boundary's reserved block (G1_G2_boundaries_reserved)
shared_planes: tok: A-in (Ti, positions 0..T-1) and E-token-in (words 0..T-1); words T..255 are the public zeros IN-00's supp_T factor forces
B_in: the B0 commitment (claims from IN-01 and block 0's slot 21) and block 0's A (x)
B_out: the B_L commitment (claims from block L-1's slot 22 and OUT-00) and A-out's x (row T-1 only)
tok (output): A-out's To-domain tok and E-token-out (one word)
